action.action-desc: Mrs. McIver (for herself and Ms. Velázquez) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Small Business

form.official-title: To direct the Associate Administrator for Veterans Business Development of the Small Business Administration to ensure compliance with certain reporting requirements, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026.

Not later than 60 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Associate Administrator for Veterans Business Development of the Small Business Administration shall develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with the requirements of section 603 of the Veterans Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development Act of 1999 (Public Law 106–50; 15 U.S.C. 657b note).
